fixtures.passage: For two n-vectors a and b, the inner product is the number a^T b = a_1 b_1 + a_2 b_2 + ... + a_n b_n: multiply the matching entries and add up the products. The Euclidean norm of a vector is ||a|| = sqrt(a^T a). Two vectors are called orthogonal when their inner product is zero.
